conditions_before_player_release: Review all patient-specific symptoms, values, timing, and differential for internal coherence.
Attach a rights-cleared ECG artifact or approve an explicitly synthetic, clinically reviewed waveform.
Verify the ECG supports the intended reference diagnosis and define competing diagnoses and scoring.
Approve disclosure wording and an evidence-linked debrief.
Record reviewer identity/role, date, scope, and any limitations.
